Most homeowners in Cary and across the greater Triangle area spend far more time indoors than they realize — and the air circulating through their homes has a direct impact on their health, energy bills, and everyday comfort. While outdoor air quality tends to get most of the public attention, indoor air can actually be two to five times more polluted than outdoor air, according to the EPA. For families in Wake County, understanding what affects indoor air quality — and how to fix it — is one of the most important (and most overlooked) parts of home comfort.

That's where Air Secure Co., LLC comes in. As a locally trusted HVAC and indoor air quality company serving Cary and the surrounding Triangle communities, Air Secure helps homeowners and businesses breathe easier through professional air quality assessments, purification systems, and year-round HVAC care.

Why Indoor Air Quality Matters

Your HVAC system does more than heat and cool your home — it's constantly circulating the air you and your family breathe. Dust, pollen, pet dander, mold spores, and everyday contaminants build up in that air over time, especially when windows stay closed during North Carolina's hot, humid summers and mild winters.

Poor indoor air quality has been linked to a range of health and comfort issues, including:

  • Increased allergy and asthma symptoms
  • Frequent headaches and fatigue
  • Dry or irritated eyes, throat, and skin
  • Disrupted sleep
  • Weakened immune response over time
  • Reduced HVAC efficiency and higher energy bills

For households with young children, older adults, pets, or family members with respiratory conditions, the effects of poor air quality can be even more pronounced. Even in a well-maintained home, indoor pollutants can quietly accumulate without any obvious warning signs — which is why professional assessment matters.

Common Indoor Air Quality Culprits in Triangle Homes

Humidity levels. North Carolina's humid summers can push indoor moisture levels too high, creating the perfect environment for mold growth and dust mites. Too little humidity in winter, on the other hand, can dry out sinuses, crack skin, and irritate the respiratory system.

Dust and allergens. Between heavy pollen seasons and everyday household dust, HVAC filters can become overwhelmed quickly if they aren't inspected and changed on a regular schedule. Once filters are clogged, they stop trapping particles effectively and can even become a source of contamination themselves.

Poor ventilation. Tightly sealed, energy-efficient homes are great for lowering utility bills, but they can also trap pollutants indoors without a proper ventilation strategy. Without fresh air exchange, indoor pollutant concentrations can build up over time.

Aging or poorly maintained HVAC systems. Older systems circulate air less effectively and are more prone to harboring dust, mold, and bacteria within their ductwork. Systems that haven't been serviced recently often make air quality problems worse rather than better.

Household chemicals and materials. Cleaning products, paint, furniture, and even carpeting can release volatile organic compounds (VOCs) into indoor air, particularly in homes with limited air exchange.

Simple Signs Your Air Quality Needs Attention

Not sure whether your home has an indoor air quality issue? Here are a few common warning signs:

  • Visible dust buildup around vents or on furniture shortly after cleaning
  • Musty or stale odors, especially in basements, closets, or humid areas
  • Increased allergy or sinus symptoms while at home
  • Condensation buildup on windows
  • Uneven humidity or "clammy" air throughout the house
  • Family members experiencing more frequent colds or respiratory irritation

If any of these sound familiar, it may be time for a professional indoor air quality evaluation.

How to Improve Indoor Air Quality

The good news is that indoor air quality is one of the most fixable comfort issues in a home. With the right combination of equipment and maintenance, most air quality problems can be significantly improved. A few of the most effective solutions include:

  1. Air purifiers — Capture airborne particles like dust, pollen, pet dander, and smoke before they circulate throughout your home.
  2. UV light systems — Installed within your HVAC system, UV lights help neutralize mold, bacteria, and viruses at the source.
  3. Humidity control — Whole-home dehumidifiers and humidifiers keep moisture levels balanced year-round, reducing mold risk and improving comfort.
  4. Ventilation improvements — Fresh-air ventilation systems bring in filtered outdoor air without sacrificing your home's energy efficiency.
  5. Routine HVAC maintenance — Regular filter changes, duct inspections, and system tune-ups keep air moving cleanly and efficiently through your home.

Combining even two or three of these solutions can make a noticeable difference in how a home feels — fewer allergy symptoms, less dust, more consistent humidity, and a fresher overall environment.

Indoor air quality is just one part of a healthy, comfortable home — and Air Secure provides complete HVAC solutions to keep every part of your system running reliably. With more than 15 years of trusted service across Wake County, Air Secure is BBB A+ accredited, licensed, and insured, offering:

  • HVAC Maintenance & Tune-Up — Scheduled inspections and adjustments that improve system durability and overall efficiency.
  • Heating Services — Reliable furnace and heat pump solutions to keep homes warm and energy-efficient, including 24-hour emergency heating service.
  • Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) Solutions — Air purifiers, UV lights, and humidity control for cleaner, healthier indoor breathing.
  • Commercial HVAC Repair — Dependable commercial system repair and service for uninterrupted business operations.
  • Furnace Repair Services — Expert furnace diagnostics and repairs that restore safe, efficient heating fast.

Whether your AC isn't cooling properly, your furnace has stopped working, or your indoor air simply feels unhealthy, the trained technicians at Air Secure diagnose issues quickly and deliver dependable, honest fixes — backed by fair pricing and a commitment to long-term comfort.

Seasonal Air Quality Tips for Wake County Homes

Because North Carolina experiences such distinct seasonal shifts, indoor air quality needs can change throughout the year. Here's what Air Secure recommends homeowners keep in mind season by season:

Spring — Pollen counts across the Triangle rise sharply, and open windows can quickly bring allergens indoors. Keeping HVAC filters fresh and running an air purifier during peak pollen weeks can make a noticeable difference for allergy sufferers.

Summer — High humidity is the biggest challenge. Without proper dehumidification, moisture can build up in ductwork and living spaces, creating conditions where mold and mildew thrive. A well-maintained AC system paired with humidity control keeps summer air both cool and dry.

Fall — As homes close up for cooler weather, it's a good time to schedule a heating tune-up and inspect ductwork for dust buildup before the furnace runs continuously through winter.

Winter — Heating systems can dry out indoor air significantly, leading to dry skin, irritated sinuses, and static buildup. A whole-home humidifier helps restore balanced moisture levels while keeping energy bills in check.

Staying ahead of these seasonal shifts — rather than reacting after symptoms appear — is one of the simplest ways Wake County homeowners can protect both their comfort and their health year-round.

The Connection Between HVAC Maintenance and Air Quality

It's easy to think of indoor air quality and HVAC maintenance as two separate issues, but they're closely connected. Your HVAC system is the primary way air moves through your home, so any inefficiency, dirt buildup, or mechanical issue within that system directly affects the air you breathe.

Regular maintenance visits allow Air Secure technicians to:

  • Inspect and replace air filters before they become clogged
  • Check ductwork for dust, debris, or signs of mold growth
  • Verify that humidity control components are functioning properly
  • Ensure UV lights and purification add-ons are working as intended
  • Catch small mechanical issues before they turn into costly repairs or air quality problems

Homeowners who schedule routine HVAC maintenance tend to notice fewer air quality complaints, more consistent comfort, and lower energy bills — all reinforcing why maintenance and air quality go hand in hand.

How do I know if my home has an indoor air quality problem? Common indicators include visible dust buildup, musty odors, increased allergy symptoms while at home, condensation on windows, and inconsistent humidity levels. A professional IAQ assessment from Air Secure can pinpoint the exact cause.

Can indoor air quality solutions help with allergies? Yes. Air purifiers and improved filtration are among the most effective tools for reducing airborne allergens like pollen, dust, and pet dander indoors.

Do UV lights actually improve air quality? UV light systems installed in HVAC systems help neutralize mold, bacteria, and certain viruses as air passes through the system, complementing filtration and purification efforts.

Is indoor air quality really worse than outdoor air? According to the EPA, indoor air can be two to five times more polluted than outdoor air due to trapped pollutants, limited ventilation, and everyday household contaminants.

item.title: 1인 개발 #4 — 회원 기능 개발 Step 1: SNS 회원가입
item.content:encoded:
0. 들어가기 전에 — 개발 하네스부터 깔았다

https://github.com/HwangJunha/ieuri-server-harness

1. 왜 헥사고날 + DDD + CQRS인가

지금은 단일 서버지만, 규모가 커지면 도메인별로 앱을 쪼갤 생각을 하고 설계했다. 그래서 처음부터 도메인 경계를 앞세웠다.

이 선택의 실익은 결합도다.

  • 도메인 모델 != JPA 엔티티 — 도메인은 순수 Kotlin, JPA @Entity는 인프라에만 둔다. 매퍼로 변환한다. 매핑 이라는 비용을 치르는 대신, 도메인이 영속성 기술에 묶이지 않는다.
  • 포트 & 어댑터 — DB, 토큰 저장소, 메일 발송 전부 포트(인터페이스) 뒤에 숨긴다. 나중에 구현만 갈아끼우면 된다.
  • CQRS — 쓰기는 도메인 애그리거트를 통과하고, 읽기는 애그리거트를 우회해 QueryDSL이 read DTO로 직접 프로젝션한다. (Step 4에서 본격 도입.)

한마디로, 지금의 편의보다 나중의 분리 비용을 더 무겁게 본 설계다. 1인 개발에서는 분명히 좋은 설계는 아니다. 만약 AI가 이렇게 까지 발전을 하지 않았다면 나도 이러한 설계를 지양했을것이다. 하지만 AI의 발전함에 따라 충분히 가치가 있을 설계라고 생각을 했고 시도를 해보았다.

현 프로젝트 구조

2. Step 1 목표

SNS(apple/google/kakao) id_token으로 신규 회원을 만든다. 흐름은:

SNS id_token 검증 → (provider, provider_user_id) 중복 확인 → 약관 동의(버전 이력) → 프로필 초기화 → 이메일 암호화 저장 → 이메일 검증 여부 판정 → (미검증 시) 6자리 코드 발급 → 감사 이력

가입은 이메일 검증 완료를 기다리지 않고 성공 처리한다. 검증은 비동기로 따라온다.

3. 가입 불변식은 도메인에서 강제한다

만 14세 미만 차단, 필수 약관 동의 — 이런 정책은 서비스 계층이 아니라 도메인 애그리거트의 팩토리에서 막는다. 여기를 통과하지 못하면 애초에 Member 객체가 만들어지지 않는다.

// domain/aggregate/Member.kt
        companion object {
        fun register(
        provider: Provider,
        providerUserId: ProviderUserId,
        submittedEmail: Email,
        providerEmail: Email?,
        providerEmailVerified: Boolean,
        // ...
        agreements: List<Agreement>,
        requiredTermsCodes: Set<String>,
        now: Instant,
        ): Member {
        require(ageVerified) { "만 14세 미만은 가입할 수 없습니다." }
        
        val agreedCodes = agreements.filter { it.agreed }.map { it.termsCode }.toSet()
        val missing = requiredTermsCodes - agreedCodes
        require(missing.isEmpty()) { "필수 약관에 동의해야 가입할 수 있습니다. 미동의: $missing" }
        
        return Member(
        // ...
        // provider가 검증한 이메일과 제출 이메일이 같을 때만 검증완료로 시작
        emailVerifiedInitial = providerEmailVerified &&
        providerEmail != null && providerEmail == submittedEmail,
        statusInitial = MemberStatus.ACTIVE,
        // ...
        )
        }
        }

4. 이메일은 평문으로 저장하지 않는다 (암호화)

개인정보라 DB에 평문으로 두지 않는다. 도메인은 평문 Email을 다루지만, 영속성 어댑터가 저장 직전에 암호화한다. 도메인은 암호화를 모른다.

// infrastructure/.../security/AesGcmEmailEncryptor.kt
        override fun encrypt(plaintext: String): String {
        val iv = ByteArray(IV_LENGTH).also { random.nextBytes(it) } // 매번 새 IV(12B)
        val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding").apply {
        init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, secretKey, GCMParameterSpec(TAG_BITS, iv))
        }
        val ciphertext = cipher.doFinal(plaintext.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
        return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(iv + ciphertext) // base64(iv || ct+tag)
        }
// infrastructure/.../persistence/MemberPersistenceAdapter.kt
        memberRepository.save(
        MemberEntity(
        provider = member.provider,
        providerUserId = member.providerUserId.value,
        emailEncrypted = encryptor.encrypt(member.email.value), // 평문 저장 금지
        // ...
        ),
        )

로컬 환경 메모. 암호화 키는 base64 32바이트 키를 설정으로 주입한다. 로컬은 application-local.yaml에 개발 전용 키를 두고, 운영은 환경변수로 주입해 기본값 없이 fail-fast 하도록 프로파일을 분리했다. DB 비밀번호·운영 암호화 키는 절대 커밋하지 않는다. 지금은 로컬 Postgres 하나로 돌리는 단계라 키 관리도 파일 수준이지만, 운영에서는 안전한 방식으로 옮길 것이다.

5. 6자리 코드 검증 — 무차별 대입을 도메인이 방어

세 가지의 기능을 캡슐화했다: ① 짧은 만료 ② 시도 횟수 제한 ③ 단회용.

// domain/aggregate/EmailVerification.kt
        fun verify(inputCodeHash: String, now: Instant): VerificationResult {
        if (consumed || verifiedAt != null)
        return VerificationResult.Failure(CONSUMED)
        if (now.isAfter(expiresAt))
        return VerificationResult.Failure(EXPIRED)
        if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
        consumed = true
        return VerificationResult.Failure(MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED)
        }
        if (inputCodeHash != codeHash) {         // 코드는 해시로만 비교
        attempts += 1
        if (attempts >= maxAttempts) consumed = true
        return VerificationResult.Failure(CODE_MISMATCH)
        }
        verifiedAt = now
        consumed = true
        return VerificationResult.Success
        }

그리고 평문 코드는 DB에 저장하지 않는다. 저장은 해시, 평문은 발송용으로 이벤트에만 실어 보낸다.

// application/service/MemberRegistrationService.kt
        if (!member.emailVerified) {
        val plainCode = codeGenerator.generate()
        val verification = EmailVerification.issue(
        codeHash = codeGenerator.hash(plainCode),  // 해시만 저장
        ttl = verificationPolicy.ttl,
        maxAttempts = verificationPolicy.maxAttempts,
        // ...
        )
        verificationRepository.save(verification)
        eventPublisher.publish(VerificationEmailRequested(member.email.value, plainCode)) // 평문은 이벤트로만
        }

로컬 환경 메모. 여기서 이벤트는 Spring ApplicationEvent로 발행하고 AFTER_COMMIT에 메일을 보낸다. 지금은 메세징 시스템이 구축 단계전이기 때문에 내부 이벤트로만 구성했고, DomainEventPublisherPort로 추상화해 뒀으니 나중에 메시징 시스템으로 갈아끼우면 된다. 메일 발송도 지금은 Gmail SMTP를 쓰지만 EmailSender 추후 Resend 혹은 Aws SES로 변경을 할 예정이다.

6. GraphQL 경계

API는 REST가 아니라 GraphQL(Netflix DGS) 이다. 리졸버는 인바운드 어댑터로 얇게 두고 애플리케이션 계층에 위임한다.

type Mutation {
        "SNS 회원가입. 가입은 이메일 검증 완료를 기다리지 않고 성공 처리된다."
        registerSnsMember(input: RegisterSnsMemberInput!): RegisterSnsMemberPayload!
        "이메일 검증 코드 확인."
        verifyEmail(input: VerifyEmailInput!): VerifyEmailPayload!
        }

7. 이번 스텝 정리 & 트레이드오프

  • 다계정 허용 — (provider, provider_user_id) UNIQUE. provider가 다르면 별개 회원으로 본다. (같은 사람이 카카오/구글로 각각 가입 가능. 통합은 나중 과제.)
  • 약관 동의는 append-only 이력 — 버전까지 남긴다. 동의/비동의 모두 기록. 약관 본문은 코드가 아니라 DB로 관리
  • SNS 서명 검증은 아직 dev 검증기 — SnsIdentityVerifierPort 뒤에 dev 구현(payload 디코드)만 뒀다. 실제 JWKS 서명 검증은 도메인 확보와 묶여 있어 별도 스텝으로 미뤘다. 구조를 안 바꾸고 구현체만 추가하면 되도록 포트를 먼저 만들기만 했다.

다음 편(Step 2): 로그인 — JWT access/refresh 발급, 회전과 재사용 감지, 그리고 refresh 저장소를 왜 In-memory로 시작했는지.
